recipe.visualDefinition: A vintage 1960s-style composition featuring a group portrait of men emerging from a plume of smoke rising from a brass oil lamp. The scene is set against a dark, heavily textured background, with the central figures framed by a glowing, ethereal aura.
coreVisualRelationships: The oil lamp at the bottom acts as the source for the central smoke portal.
The arched typography follows the curve of the smoke aura.
The group portrait is layered with a soft-focus, golden-hued glow.
Heavy film grain and surface distress unify the dark background and the central image.
coreInvariants: Central smoke-ring portal framing the subjects
Brass oil lamp at the bottom center
Arched display text at the top
High-contrast dark background with visible dust and scratches

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five to six men positioned centrally within a circular smoke frame, occupying the middle 60% of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brass oil lamp at the bottom center serves as the physical anchor for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the lamp, follows the smoke upward into the faces, and then curves along the arched text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black, textured negative space surrounds the central circular vignette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm golden-yellow and amber for the smoke glow and highlights on the faces.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blue and orange within the typography and clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the glowing portal and the dark surroundings.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and decorative display faces
letterConstructionRules: Primary text follows a convex upward arc
Secondary text uses a decorative, liquid-like serif style
Thick, blocky strokes with sharp, exaggerated serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title have a slight 3D extrusion or drop shadow effect
The 'R' and 'S' in the secondary title have elongated, flowing terminals

composition.relationshipToImage: Frames the top of the smoke portal

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, arched slab serif paired with a smaller, more ornate psychedelic serif for the subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky serifs

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, textured background with a brass oil lamp at the bottom. A plume of smoke rises from the lamp, forming a circular, glowing portal. Inside the portal, place a soft-focus group portrait of men in 1960s attire with a golden-yellow color cast. Apply heavy film grain and dust textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add arched, heavy slab-serif text across the top, following the curve of the smoke portal. Place a secondary, decorative serif title immediately below it, centered.

verificationChecks: Does the smoke form a clear circular frame?
Is the background sufficiently dark and textured?
Is the oil lamp the clear source of the smoke?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the portrait
mustRedesign: Specific faces of the band members
Exact song titles and catalog numbers

mustAchieve: Cohesive integration of smoke and portrait

postGenerationChecks: Check for visible film grain and dust artifacts.
Ensure the lamp looks like a physical object in the scene.
Verify the glow doesn't wash out the facial features entirely.
Confirm the typography feels integrated into the curve of the smoke.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central mystical portal framed by smoke, a physical source object at the base, and arched heavy-weight display typography to create a vintage psychedelic layout.
